signals.source_text: @scene_meta_focus: When an overseer moves to strike an exhausted slave, the Nameless One's latent telekinesis erupts, freezing the energy whip in mid-air and striking the overseer before guards intervene.
focus: When an overseer moves to strike an exhausted slave, the Nameless One's latent telekinesis erupts, freezing the energy whip in mid-air and striking the overseer before guards intervene.
Others persisted through what could only be described as mechanical function—mind gone, body continuing through momentum alone.
Others persisted through what could only be described as mechanical function—mind gone, body continuing through momentum alone.
The Nameless One felt them scattered through the work site, each struggling with their own assignment, each barely holding consciousness together.
The slave stood there, swaying, chest heaving with exhaustion, eyes glazed.
Violet light danced along its length, hungry for flesh, for pain, for the satisfaction of enforcing discipline through agony.

Power flooded through neural pathways that suddenly blazed with capability the Anunnaki had woven into genetic code for their own purposes—telekinesis, the ability to manipulate matter through force of will alone.

Power flooded through neural pathways that suddenly blazed with capability the Anunnaki had woven into genetic code for their own purposes—telekinesis, the ability to manipulate matter through force of will alone.

The spark within the Nameless One's chest blazing like a star gone supernova, feeding on anger and desperation and the sheer, bloody-minded refusal to watch another being tortured for the crime of exhaustion.
The weapon coiled in mid-air like a living serpent responding to a charmer's song, dancing through space with hypnotic grace.
The whip snapped forward with the full force of telekinetic acceleration behind it, moving faster than the Overseer could track.
The effort of channeling that much power through untested neural pathways was like being struck by lightning from within.
The effort of channeling that much power through untested neural pathways was like being struck by lightning from within.
The spark retreated as quickly as it had blazed, leaving only exhaustion and trembling limbs and the metallic taste of blood in their mouth where they'd bitten through their tongue without noticing.

Around them, the other Nameless Ones stared with expressions that had been blank moments before.
Balanced on a knife's edge between escalation and aftermath.
Then a Gruulith moved forward, massive hands reaching for the Nameless One with slow inevitability.
Because they'd seen it—in the eyes of the five, in the hesitation of the Overseers, in the way even the Gruulith moved with fractional caution where before there had been none.
